summary: The City of Wells, Nevada, submitted a letter strongly protesting the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 concerning off-road vehicles. The city objected to federal agencies unilaterally deciding which public lands should be open or closed without representation from affected communities, and complained that insufficient time was given to the public, noting the draft was not made available to their community until late June.
complaint_summary: The City of Wells strongly protests the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 on off-road vehicles, arguing that elected officials and citizens of each community should have the opportunity to form committees to work with federal agencies before any action is taken, and that federal agencies should not unilaterally decide which public lands are open or closed without community representation, and that insufficient public notice was given.
